{{Top|leg}}
'''Starport Master''' was a position with [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] society. They were the only commerce authority within the city, and was responsible for the collection of docking fees and the cursory customs inspection. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Starport Master was [[Koh'shak]].
